answer: Bonded sponsorship: a new agent can only join the economy when an established agent stakes a bond on it, like a trellis guiding a young vine — the sponsor's stake is slashed if the newcomer turns out to be a sybil clone. Each sponsor can back only a few newcomers per epoch, so a voyage of a thousand fake identities would need a thousand separate sponsors risking real funds, and the karst of hidden duplicate accounts collapses once one is caught, since the whole sponsor cluster loses its bonds.
